- rf-appium: Writes and fixes Robot Framework mobile tests with AppiumLibrary for Android/iOS native, hybrid and mobile-web apps: Open Application with W3C capabilities (UiAutomator2, XCUITest), accessibility_id/id/xpath locators, waits, swipes, scrolling, WEBVIEW context switching. Use when a suite imports `Library    AppiumLibrary`, or the user mentions Appium, an .apk/.ipa, an emulator or simulator with Robot Framework. For desktop apps use rf-platynui; for desktop browsers use rf-browser or rf-selenium.
- rf-browser: Writes and fixes Robot Framework web UI tests with Browser Library (robotframework-browser, Playwright): New Browser/Context/Page, CSS/text/XPath selectors, auto-waiting assertions (Get Text with ==), iframes (>>>), shadow DOM, tabs, downloads, storage state. Use when a .robot or .resource file imports `Library    Browser`, the user mentions Browser Library, Playwright or rfbrowser, or wants a web test with no library chosen yet. For SeleniumLibrary/WebDriver suites use rf-selenium; for installing the library use rf-setup.
- rf-language: Writes and reviews Robot Framework test cases and suites in keyword-driven, Given/When/Then (BDD) or data-driven style (Test Template), and user keywords, resource files and variables: embedded and typed arguments, RETURN, VAR scopes, control structures, YAML or Python variable files. Use when writing or restructuring tests or keywords in .robot, .resource or __init__.robot files, choosing Test Tags or [Arguments], replacing Force Tags, [Return], Run Keyword If or Set Suite Variable, or fixing 'Multiple keywords with name'. Not for Python keyword libraries or listeners (use rf-python-library); for library keywords use rf-browser, rf-requests or another library skill.
